name: browser-engine-adapter
description: Internal Browser Engine Adapter contract for attaching real browser engines to Runtime stream sessions
author: elastos

authority.reason: Defines the internal browser-engine adapter contract without exposing raw sockets, host browser APIs, wallet injection, filesystem access, or host internet access to app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from browser-engine-adapter authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.
